hero.name: Raphaël Baëza
hero.tagline: Product Manager — Strong tech background — Bridge between business and engineering
hero.subtitle: Welcome to my personal space. Explore my journey, my projects, and what drives me.

about.title: About
about.p1: I'm Raphaël, a Product Manager with a strong technical background. I started in networking and cybersecurity before moving into managing complex digital projects. This hybrid path lets me understand both the constraints of engineering teams and business stakes — and act as a real bridge between them.
about.p2: I've worked on blockchain platforms, international real-estate digitization, and highly regulated environments.
about.p3: What drives me: turning fuzzy ideas into concrete products, with tight-knit teams and delivery that holds up its promises.

items.title: Product Manager & Product Owner — Freelance
items.description: End-to-end leadership of a blockchain-based iGaming platform with smart contracts. Scoping, multi-team coordination (engineering, design, QA, marketing, ops), spec writing (API, smart contracts), pre-prod testing (Postman, UI walkthroughs), and international releases with stakeholders across multiple countries. Set up a transparent communication framework to defuse internal tensions and build real team cohesion.

items.title: Scrum Master — Freelance
items.place: Furo · Paris / Los Angeles · Real-estate investment digitization platform (USA)
items.description: Structured agile processes for a team split across two time zones to digitize investment in US construction projects. Process owner, communication facilitator, dependency and sync management.

items.title: Sales Advisor — Chocolats Alain Ducasse
items.description: A deliberate detour during my career transition — working at a top-tier maison. Attention to detail, sense of service, premium client relations. A short but formative experience: care given to every interaction, with a client or a stakeholder, makes all the difference.

items.title: Project Manager & Production Assistant — Protectman
items.place: Meudon · Anti-fall safety systems (height work, treetop adventure courses)
items.description: Introduced agile practices from scratch in an SMB specialized in regulated safety equipment. Team coordination, direct relationship with leadership, wearing multiple hats: facilitator, coordinator, proactive contributor.

items.title: Systems & Network Engineer — Tribord
items.description: Managing network infrastructure (VPN, firewalls, switches), internal and client support. First taste of project management: explaining tech to non-tech stakeholders, coordinating interventions, proposing improvements.

items.title: Support Technician then Network Administrator — Midrange
items.description: 4 years building hands-on skills: level 2 and 3 troubleshooting, datacenter ops at Equinix, network infrastructure deployments. The solid technical foundation everything else was built on.

items.name: PDF-App
items.description: Full-stack web app for fitness and nutrition (in development). Upload PDFs of training programs or recipes, AI extracts structured data automatically (ingredients, shopping lists, exercises). A side-project blending tech and physical optimization.

items.title: Basketball
items.description: Certified FFBB referee at department level and coach. Basketball taught me to read team play, make fast decisions under pressure, and understand how each role matters within a team.

items.title: Video games & board games
items.description: A passion since childhood. I enjoy diving into a great solo game just as much as joining a multiplayer match. Board games hold a special place: there's something irreplaceable about sitting around a table — I love revisiting classics as much as discovering new titles.

items.title: History
items.description: History fascinates me as a whole — from the earliest civilizations to the modern era. Understanding how the world was built, the decisions that changed everything, the events no one saw coming. A way to stay alert to the world around us.
